same email and password: that succeeds when the first attempt created the account.

post.description:
Invite someone by email to a studio (admins; inviting an owner needs an owner).

A new invitation for the same address replaces the previous one.

Start a job that only counts through its steps, for checking that jobs work in a
deployment and for trying out a client. It uses no AI and costs nothing. A workspace
can have one demo job at a time, so the shared queue stays free for real work.

get.description: A job's status, progress, and its result or error once it has ended.
Follow a job as it happens.

200.description: Server-sent events. Each `job` event carries the job (as getJob returns it): first its current state, then each change. The stream ends after the job has succeeded or failed (clients should then stop following), or after 10 minutes (reconnect to go on). Lines starting with ':' only keep the connection alive.

204.description: A reconnect (with Last-Event-ID) to a job that has ended: nothing more will come, and browsers' EventSource stops reconnecting.
